comment: Every tree model Omberg can draw (CONTEXT.md 'Model library'). id: arborist:<Arborist catalogue label> or vsp:<Unity prefab>; renderer: what draws it in GSPro. Sizes: a vsp model's from the Unity catalogue, an Arborist model's from data/arborist/catalog-sizes.json (first LOD). The palette refers to these by id. Beech and elm are Arborist-only (Marcus, Arborist Ultra lineup 2026-10-18); the S7 elm's look is his darkened one. Add one: bun run models -- add "Ombergs Golfklubb" arborist:<label> --species <species>. Poplars, pines, firs and dwarf pines are Arborist models since 2026-10-20 (their looks moved here from arborist-species.json). billboardAs (a vsp model): the Arborist model drawn as its billboard where the routing makes the tree one (vegetation-rules.json `routing`).

models.note: Hole 18's big dead oak (Marcus 2026-10-18): Arborist's leafless Amur cork tree in the weathered grey of dead oak with a little brown in it. Tried in Arborist Ultra: bleached white (#ece9e2, brightness 0.15) read too white close up, brown-grey #c2b6a4 / saturation 0.25 too brown; this is his 'more grey than brown, a slight brown tone in the grey'. Placed only by tree edit: disabled in the palette, species without a weight.

Hole 14's round bush in front of the big pine right of the fairway (Marcus 2026-10-18: a wide bush, not a willow; NatureManufacture's hazel was a sparse sapling). CESimgolf's buckthorn, the densest round bush in Arborist's catalogue, lightened ('nr 2, något ljusare och större'). Placed only by tree edit; disabled in the palette.
